requirements.evidence: Migrations match the spec: `entities_slug_unique` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:17-19) and memberships FKs/cascade, role default employee, generated `owner_seq` plus `entity_memberships_one_owner` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:17-26). Contract models/enum/policies are present (app/Models/Entity.php:12-48, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12-67, app/Models/UserRole.php:5-18, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:13-47, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:13-53). Session dispatch, middleware, routes, onboarding retry/reserved slug/soft-delete, dashboard 403 and switcher/navbar are implemented (app/Tenancy/CurrentEntity.php:23-64, app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:23-34, routes/web.php:23-30, app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:29-88, resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:9-19, resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:14-16).

conventions.evidence: Uses `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:26-31), policies for authorization (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php), migrations with reversible `down()` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:26-29), `#[Fillable]` (app/Models/Entity.php:12) and existing Blade components/layouts (resources/views/livewire/entity/create-entity.blade.php:5). Deviations: entity creation is a domain write performed in the component instead of `app/Actions/*` (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:93-105), and the custom `current_entity` middleware is not registered with `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware` (app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:15-19).

security.evidence: Authorization is server-side in submit/mount/pick (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:33, app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:17-19, app/Http/Controllers/Entity/EntityPickController.php:17); input is validated (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:26); output is escaped and the model is `#[Locked]` (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:14). Gap: the custom `current_entity` authorization middleware is not persisted for Livewire update requests, so it silently stops applying after the initial page load (bootstrap/app.php:19-21, app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:15-19).

tests.evidence: Five new Pest files cover the data model and DB constraints (tests/Feature/EntityDataModelTest.php:19-168), all policies including owner protection (tests/Feature/EntityPolicyTest.php:23-154), session/middleware/pick/switcher/navbar (tests/Feature/EntitySessionTest.php:28-223), onboarding race/retry/audit/validation/locales (tests/Feature/EntityOnboardingTest.php:85-200) and dashboard 403 plus `#[Locked]` tamper (tests/Feature/EntityDashboardTest.php:25-53). Missing: a test that exercises a Livewire update request with the `current_entity` middleware, which is why the persistent-middleware gap is not caught.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing `default-page`/`card-page` layouts and `x-form-field`/`x-button` components (resources/views/livewire/entity/create-entity.blade.php:5-7, resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:1), with small focused classes. Some duplication: the session-empty 0/1/many dispatch exists in both `HomeController` and `ResolveCurrentEntity` (app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:18-22 vs app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:25-29).

readability.evidence: Clear names and docblocks (app/Tenancy/CurrentEntity.php:10-46, app/Tenancy/TenantContext.php:10-27, app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:67-92), small methods and consistent sibling style. The `EntityMembership|RedirectResponse` union plus `instanceof` checks in two callers (app/Tenancy/CurrentEntity.php:47, app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:18-22) is slightly awkward.

scope.evidence: The diff only touches the entity model/policies/tenancy/onboarding/switcher/dashboard, lang, routes, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG; no members/settings pages, Accept-Language middleware, Alpine navbar redesign or card-centering changes (task.md:97-103). The deleted home.blade.php is replaced by the required /home dispatch (routes/web.php:23).

issues.explanation: The custom `current_entity` authorization middleware is only aliased for the initial route match and is never registered with `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware`, so it stops running on `/livewire/update` requests and the tenant/403 guard silently disappears after the dashboard loads; conventions.md (Livewire security rule 6) says such a change is blocked in review.

Creating the entity and its owner membership is a domain write performed inside the Livewire component; conventions.md requires domain writes to go through an `app/Actions/*` class that authorizes inside the action.
The dashboard test covers the locked-property tamper but nothing exercises a Livewire update request, so the missing persistent `current_entity` middleware is not detected by the suite.
The session-empty 0/1/many dispatch is duplicated from `ResolveCurrentEntity` instead of reusing the middleware or a shared `CurrentEntity` method.
Returning `EntityMembership|RedirectResponse` forces both callers to do `instanceof` checks; a small result object or a nullable return with an explicit redirect would read more clearly.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model, policies, tenant session, onboarding, switcher and dashboard thoroughly, with strong tests and updated docs. The main blocker is that the custom `current_entity` authorization middleware is not registered with `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware`, so it stops applying on Livewire update requests; entity creation also bypasses the project's Action convention. Overall 3: needs changes before merging.
